rules.statement: Payments under deeds of covenant can be considered as 'annuities' for the purposes of tax deductions.
rules.supporting_quote: "The two sums could fairly be described as " annuities " within the meaning of section 15 (1) (a) of the Income Tax Ordinance. The word " annuity " does not mean only a purchased annuity."

meta.parties: Comissioner of Inland Revenue v. Rajaratnam
